raw_segments.text: Women are supposed to possess more sensibility, and even humanity, than men, and their strong
attachments and instantaneous emotions of compassion are given as proofs.
But the clinging affection of ignorance has seldom anything noble in it, and may mostly
be resolved into selfishness, as well as the affection of children and brutes.
I have known many weak women whose sensibility was entirely engrossed by their husbands,
and as for their humanity, it was very faint indeed, or rather it was only a transient
Humanity does not consist in a squeamish ear, says an eminent orator.
It belongs to the mind as well as the nerves.
